report.summary: 8 reviewed findings turned into 8 delivery items, ordered by severity and dependency.
risks: Assumption that council/bus.py and memory/recall.py exist and contain isolation enforcement
Assumption that freeze_selection, apply_test_overlay, validate_task are defined and testable
Assumption that picker.py uses type edges from modules with ambiguous names

items.title: Add verify() call before each read in containment.py
items.why_now: Cross-module race condition (high severity) requires verify() at each read to prevent file swap or incomplete log.

steps.do: In containment.py, ensure verify() is called before every read operation on LowIntegrityLog.
steps.verified_by: Test test_verify_before_read: mock verify() and assert it is called before each read.

items.assumption: LowIntegrityLog.verify() method exists and is effective.

items.title: Add wait() before reading log in evolution.py
items.why_now: Cross-module race condition (high severity) requires evolution.py to wait for process termination before reading log.

steps.do: In evolution.py, call wait() on the subprocess before reading the log.
steps.verified_by: Test test_wait_before_read: mock wait() and assert it is called before log reading.

items.assumption: evolution.py spawns a subprocess and has a wait() method.

items.title: Replace broad except with specific exceptions in run_checks
items.why_now: Broad except (high severity) masks unexpected errors, contradicting fail-closed philosophy.

steps.do: In daedalus/lanes/checks.py, replace except Exception with except (specific exceptions) or re-raise unexpected ones.
steps.verified_by: Test test_run_checks_fail_closed: inject an unexpected error and assert it propagates.

items.assumption: The specific exceptions that can be raised are known.

items.title: Add test for unknown event type in event_to_transport_record
items.why_now: Unvalidated transport (high severity) raises KeyError for unknown event types; needs test to document and fix.

steps.do: Add a test that calls event_to_transport_record with an unknown event type and expects KeyError.
steps.verified_by: Test test_unknown_event_transport: run and verify KeyError is raised.

steps.do: Fix event_to_transport_record to handle unknown types gracefully (e.g., return a default record or raise a custom exception).

items.assumption: TransportRecord.from_dict raises KeyError on missing keys.

items.title: Add test for absolute path in resolve_python_imports
items.why_now: Path resolution discrepancy (medium severity) may cause import failures if reach.py expects relative paths.

steps.do: Add a test that passes an absolute path to resolve_python_imports and verify it works.
If test fails, update reach.py to handle absolute paths or ensure mint.py passes relative paths.

items.assumption: resolve_python_imports implementation is complete enough to test.

items.title: Verify no file is locked by multiple lock primitives
items.why_now: Lock primitive duplication (low severity) could cause conflicts if locks overlap; needs verification.

steps.do: Check all usages of budget_lock, promotion_lock, room_lock to ensure they lock different files.
steps.verified_by: No file is locked by more than one lock; document findings.

steps.do: If overlap found, create a shared lock primitive or ensure consistency.
steps.verified_by: All locks use the same implementation for overlapping resources.

items.assumption: Current lock implementations are correct for their resources.

items.title: Search for isolation enforcement in council/bus.py and memory/recall.py
items.why_now: Isolation enforcement gap (high severity) promises enforcement but may be missing; needs audit.

steps.do: Search daedalus/council/bus.py for any filter that prevents council store from being read.
Search daedalus/memory/recall.py for similar isolation enforcement.

items.assumption: Files exist and contain relevant logic.

items.title: Locate and review tests for freeze_selection, apply_test_overlay, validate_task
items.why_now: Gate contract unverified (needs evidence) requires verifying these functions are tested.

steps.do: Find definitions of freeze_selection, apply_test_overlay, validate_task in the codebase.
steps.verified_by: List file paths and line numbers.
Tests cover edge cases and pass.

items.title: Check if picker.py uses type edges from ambiguous modules
items.why_now: Type resolution ambiguity (medium severity) may miss type edges used by picker.

steps.do: Inspect picker.py's hotspot_candidates to see if it uses type edges from modules with ambiguous names.
If yes, add a test with a known ambiguous package to verify correct resolution.

items.assumption: picker.py has a method hotspot_candidates that uses type edges.
